Maya: Postmortem follow-up  we distilled the action items into three remediation cards. Need owners, ETAs, and clear acceptance criteria so we can move to the remediation board.
Owen: Ill claim CARD-7210 (kv-cache eviction tuning + telemetry). Will add perf plan + acceptance criteria by tomorrow EOD.
Pri: Thanks Owen. Please include a monthly regression job and a dashboard link so we can detect the recurring 1st-of-month spike.
Owen: Will do. Proposed acceptance: p95 < 85ms on canary, sustained hit-rate > 93%. ETA Thu-2024-06-13.
Liam: I can take CARD-7224 (failover orchestration + runbook). Creating Jira now.
Liam: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CARD-7224  stub created, ETA 5 business days. I'll add a staged canary and rollback steps.
Pri: CARD-7239 (capacity alert & autoscale thresholds) looks infra-heavy. Eng-infra should be R. I'll be A for verification. @eng-infra please nominate a primary.
incident-bot: Reminder  owners must add due dates and acceptance criteria in Jira within 48 hours.
Owen: CARD-7210 updated: perf plan + test harness uploaded, monthly smoke job configured, tagged "postmortem-action".
Liam: CARD-7224 runbook draft uploaded; included automation safety checks and a dry-run checklist. ETA Wed-2024-06-19.
Pri: Eng-infra nominated Diego as primary for CARD-7239. Diego will post ETA by EOD tomorrow. RACI suggestion: CARD-7210 R=Owen A=Pri C=SRE I=Oncall; CARD-7224 R=Liam A=Maya C=Platform I=PMs; CARD-7239 R=Diego A=Pri C=Eng-Infra I=Customers.
Maya: That RACI looks good. I'll run weekly remediation syncs until all three close, then a monthly audit for the next quarter. I'll send invites.
Pri: Added brief recurrence note to CARD-7210 summarizing prior monthly spikes so future owners see the pattern.
incident-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 2024-06-15 to check progress on CARD-7210/CARD-7224/CARD-7239.
Maya: Thanks all. If you need a handoff for rollout testing, ping me and I'll pair on the dry-run. :white_check_mark:
